goal: Defeat Brock for the Boulder Badge

subgoals.goal_text: Go to Pallet Town and deliver Oak's Parcel to Professor Oak.
Travel north through Viridian City and Route 2 to enter Viridian Forest.
Battle wild Pokemon in Viridian Forest until Charmander reaches level 12.
Navigate through Viridian Forest to reach the north exit.
Travel north from Route 2 into Pewter City.
Visit the Pewter City Pokemon Center to fully heal the party.
Enter the Pewter City Gym to challenge Brock.
Defeat Brock in battle to earn the Boulder Badge.
